messages:
Anya Li: Heads up
- GCP Marketplace invoice for Mar shows a chargeback from ResellerBridge for OmniTech but we also have a full charge on our side. Need quick reconciliation before close.
Ravi Gupta: Can you paste invoice id and the affected line(s)? I can open a GCP billing case.
Anya Li: Invoice `GCP-INV-2026-03-OMT-7721`
Anya Li: Snippet from the billing csv:
```
line_item,sku,description,amount
5511,RB-RESELLER,OmniTech monthly seats,24000
5512,RB-RESELLER,OmniTech monthly seats,-24000
```
Jordan Kim: Looks like a charge and a reversal landed on the consolidated bill. Do we recognize the reversal automatically? Accounting?
Ravi Gupta: Not until we get confirmation from GCP or ResellerBridge. Opening support case now.
ResellerBridge Billing: We submitted a partner-level reversal on Mar 10 after OmniTech disputed a duplicate seat. We expected a net zero on settlement. Uploading our audit log.
GCP Marketplace Support: Received case. Please provide partner registration `RB-3092` and the transaction IDs for both lines. We'll check if a settlement mismatch caused both entries to post to your invoice.
Anya Li: Partner ID `RB-3092`. Transaction IDs in CSV: `tx-5511` and `tx-5512`.
billing-bot: Alert: marketplace reversal pattern detected. Suggest label `gcp-reversal-dispute`.
Ravi Gupta: From a cashflow perspective, block recognition of the net charge until we get GCP confirmation. I'll flag in the GL as disputed.
Jordan Kim: PartnerBridge says they reversed on their side; if GCP hasn't applied the reversal, we should escalate. Can someone from ops escalate with GCP?
Ravi Gupta: Escalation request sent to GCP billing ops. Case GCP-2026-4451. ETA unknown.
ResellerBridge Billing: We'll provide a signed reversal note once GCP confirms. Expect partner credit within 3 business days after confirmation.
Anya Li: Month-end in 6 days. I'll add a blocking entry to close plan and notify RevOps.
billing-bot: Reminder: tag this thread with `marketplace` + `RB-3092` for reporting and attach reversal note when received.
Jordan Kim: Adding note to OmniTech account to prevent duplicate customer invoices.
Ravi Gupta: Will follow up every 4 hours until resolved. :hourglass:
